decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes Kess, Dissident Mage's ability to cast instant and sorcery spells from the graveyard to maintain control over the game. The deck includes a variety of powerful spells such as Demonic Tutor, Force of Will, and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to manipulate the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's plans. By efficiently handling threats and maintaining card advantage, this control deck aims to outlast the opponent and control the pace of the game until it can secure a win through either overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells or grinding them down slowly.

This deck is focused on utilizing the powerful combination of the partners Yoshimaru and Kraum to aggressively control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With a mix of counterspells like Force of Will and Mana Leak, removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares, and powerful creatures like Adeline and Thalia, this deck aims to apply pressure while keeping the opponent on the back foot. The inclusion of cards like Gideon Blackblade and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional control elements, while cards like Umezawa's Jitte and Shadowspear help to enhance your creatures in combat. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy, ensuring consistency in casting your spells and deploying threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using a combination of powerful creatures and impactful spells to apply pressure on the opponent. The commanders, Veteran Soldier and Gut, True Soul Zealot, provide a strong aggressive presence on the battlefield. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats while also utilizing cards like Embercleave and Skullclamp to enhance the offensive capabilities of the creatures. With a mix of fast creatures like Goblin Guide and powerful anthem effects like Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a decisive victory through a combination of smart combat plays and efficient card advantage.

The main focus of this aggressive deck is to deploy fast and efficient threats on the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures with haste, like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike to deal direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Tajic, Legion's Edge and Hero of Oxid Ridge provide additional sources of damage and resilience to removal spells. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Mana Tithe and Path to Exile. Overall, the strategy revolves around a proactive playstyle, aiming to close out the game as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on utilizing Golos, Tireless Pilgrim as the commander to ramp and control the game. The key strategy involves controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Abrupt Decay, while also utilizing creatures like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Palace Jailer to create advantage. The deck also includes a toolbox approach with cards like Birthing Pod and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific answers. Additionally, the deck is able to generate value through cards like Coiling Oracle and Knight of Autumn. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while maintaining control of the board through a combination of removal, creatures, and utility spells.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By combining the abilities of the Partner commanders, Gut and Faceless One, the deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of powerful cards like Embercleave, Umezawa's Jitte, and Swords to Plowshares ensures that the deck can deal with threats efficiently and close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck, allowing for consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, this deck is built to deliver fast and impactful plays, putting the opponent on the back foot from the very beginning.

This deck revolves around controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. The commander, Tivit, Seller of Secrets, helps generate card advantage and control the board. The deck includes a variety of counterspells like Force of Will and Mana Leak, removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Toxic Deluge, and card draw cards like Ponder and Archmage's Charm. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, protect your own threats, and outvalue them in the long run. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria also helps in gaining control of the game and securing a win.

This control deck focuses on utilizing Tivit, Seller of Secrets as the commander to manipulate the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck includes a variety of powerful control cards such as Force of Will, Counterspell, Cryptic Command, and Supreme Verdict to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own. It also features a selection of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push, Swords to Plowshares, and Vindicate to deal with threats on the board. Additionally, the deck includes powerful card draw engines like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Snapcaster Mage to ensure a steady stream of resources. The goal is to control the game, outvalue opponents, and ultimately emerge victorious through superior card advantage and disruption.
